reviews.title: Extremely good performance if you get one from the right batch, good price even at the rated speeds
reviews.comment: Excellent performance, even almost doubling the rated speeds. This may not be guaranteed with every individual unit; they may change component specifications occasionally to reduce costs or because of availability (many SSD makers do this). The rated speeds are not all that impressive, but good enough for the price and matching others in its class, which is what I expected when buying it. The pseudo-SLC cache is smaller than many other drives that use the full capacity dynamically, but this will only matter if there is very large amount of writing without idle time for recovery. It is DRAM-less, so some workloads may suffer slightly, but for most uses that doesn't matter. With SSD prices jumping significantly right now, this would be a good option to save some money without losing much performance.
reviews.author: Joseph Fuller

reviews.title: Pretty comparible to a Samsung 980 Pro
reviews.comment: Was worried the speeds would be slower than advertised but this is pretty fast. Compared to my Samsung 980 PRO 2T M.2 drive, the Patriot reads faster and writes slower in the sequential test.
reviews.author: Jeffrey

reviews.title: High value drive that helped me sell my computer.
reviews.comment: This Patriot P400 Lite 250GB SSD was a great value purchase that allowed me to get one of my computers ready to sell.  It provided a noticeable speed boost, making the machine much more appealing. Installation was simple and it performed as expected. Overall, a solid drive and a good purchase.
reviews.author: Adrian Nuno

reviews.title: Fast,  lots of storage and a good price!!
reviews.comment: Insanely fast!!  Wowzors!  This just puts pc's on next level storage speeds.  I have zero fears of data loss,  durability seems strong.  The performance matched up with a 870e Taichi and 9950x3d is INSANE!  Heat is a non issue on this drive for me.  I ended up using this as my secondary data drive.
